This plot here in Mtwara is sandy and the rains can be tricky, so I must farm carefully with what I have. Fertilizer is expensive and hard to find around here, and for maize on my own land I have never really used it — I rely on clearing the field well and weeding often. I will plant the maize seed I saved from last season like most of my neighbours, and I will ask my cousin and a few others to help me with the heavy weeding when the rains come strong. Pesticide and irrigation are not things I can manage — I watch the sky and pull pests by hand if they come.
